title: User profile validator

Each tuple contains a string username, an integer age which might be missing, a string email which might be absent, a string phone which might be missing, and a string biography which might be missing. Define a user profile class with these optional fields. Write a helper function to categorize age, taking an integer which might be missing and returning a string or missing. Write a helper to extract the email domain, taking a string which might be missing and returning a string or missing. Write a helper to format the phone, taking a string which might be missing and returning a string or missing. Write a helper to check if the biography is short, taking a string which might be missing and returning a boolean. The main function returns a list of usernames for profiles that have an extracted email domain and a categorized age. For an input list with a tuple of alice, twenty, alice at example dot com, missing, missing, the output is a list containing alice.

title: Binary Search Tree
spec: Implement a binary search tree to store integers. Create an entry function `search(values)` that takes a list of integers, builds a tree, and then finds the maximum depth. First define a node class with an integer value, a left child which might be missing, and a right child which might be missing. Next write a helper to insert a new integer into a node which might be missing, returning the new or updated node which might be missing. Write another helper to find a specific integer in a tree starting from a node which might be missing, returning the found node or missing if not found. Write a third helper to find the minimum value starting from a node which might be missing, returning the node or missing. Finally write a helper to calculate the maximum depth of a node which might be missing, returning an integer. The entry function should insert all values sequentially starting from a missing root, then return the maximum depth of the root node. If the input is a list with five, three, and seven, the output is two.

title: E-commerce product filter

Each tuple has a string name, an integer price which might be missing, a string category which might be missing, an integer rating which might be missing, and a string color which might be missing. Create a helper to format the category taking a string which might be missing and returning an uppercase string or missing. Create a helper to check if the rating is high taking an integer which might be missing and returning a boolean. The main function returns a list of names for products that have a high rating and a calculated discounted price. Example input is a list with a tuple of laptop, one thousand, electronics, five, black. Output is a list containing laptop.

If input is a list with a tuple of users, ten, missing, descending, role, output is a list containing users.

title: Weather station record processing

title: Calendar event scheduler

title: Health tracker data analyzer

Each tuple contains a string date, an integer step count which might be missing, an integer heart rate which might be missing, an integer sleep hours which might be missing, and an integer calories burned which might be missing. Create a helper to evaluate heart rate taking an integer which might be missing and returning a string zone or missing. Create a helper to check sleep taking an integer which might be missing and returning a boolean if it is sufficient. Create a helper to calculate calorie balance taking an integer which might be missing and returning an integer or missing. Output is a list with monday.

title: Flight booking search
spec: Search for flights with flexible criteria. The entry function `search(queries)` receives a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string destination, a string return date which might be missing, a string preferred airline which might be missing, an integer maximum stops which might be missing, and a string seat class which might be missing. Define a flight query class with these optional fields. Write a helper to parse the return date taking a string which might be missing returning a formatted date string or missing. Write a helper to standardize the airline name taking a string which might be missing returning an uppercase string or missing. Write a helper to evaluate maximum stops taking an integer which might be missing returning a string category or missing. Write a helper to validate seat class taking a string which might be missing returning a boolean. The main function returns a list of destinations for queries that have a valid seat class and a standardized airline name. If input is london, tomorrow, delta, one, economy, output is a list with london.

title: Library book search
spec: Filter library catalog entries. The entry function `catalog(books)` takes a list of tuples representing books. Each tuple has a string title, a string author which can be missing, an integer publication year which can be missing, a string genre which can be missing, and a string international standard book number which can be missing. Define a book class with these optional fields. Create a helper function to format the author name taking a string which can be missing and returning a title cased string or missing. Create a helper to categorize the year taking an integer which can be missing and returning a string era or missing. Create a helper to standardize genre taking a string which can be missing and returning an uppercase string or missing. Create a helper to validate the book number taking a string which can be missing and returning a boolean. Output is a list containing foundation.

title: REST API response parser
spec: Parse responses from an external service. The entry function `parse(responses)` takes a list of tuples. Each tuple has an integer status code, a string error message which can be missing, a string data payload which can be missing, a string status text which can be missing, and a string request identifier which can be missing. Define a response object class with these optional fields. Write a helper function to extract the error code taking a string error message which can be missing and returning a string or missing. Write a helper to decode the payload taking a string which can be missing and returning a string or missing. Write a helper to format the status text taking a string which can be missing and returning an uppercase string or missing. Write a helper to validate the request identifier taking a string which can be missing and returning a boolean. Output is a list containing success data.

title: Vehicle listing filter
spec: Filter cars for sale based on user preferences. The entry function `filter(listings)` takes a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string title, a string make which might be missing, a string model which might be missing, an integer year which might be missing, and an integer mileage which might be missing. Define a car listing class with these optional fields. Write a helper to standardize the make taking a string which might be missing and returning a capitalized string or missing. Write a helper to format the model taking a string which might be missing and returning an uppercase string or missing. Write a helper to categorize the year taking an integer which might be missing and returning a string like classic or modern or missing. Write a helper to check if mileage is low taking an integer which might be missing and returning a boolean. The main function returns a list of titles for listings that have low mileage and a standardized make. For input of fast car, ford, mustang, two thousand twenty, ten thousand, output is a list containing fast car.

title: Real estate property search
spec: Search for homes using flexible criteria. The entry function `search(properties)` takes a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string address, an integer bedrooms which can be absent, an integer bathrooms which can be absent, an integer square feet which can be absent, and an integer lot size which can be absent. Define a property class with these optional fields. Write a helper to categorize bedrooms taking an integer which can be absent and returning a string size category or missing. Write a helper to evaluate bathrooms taking an integer which can be absent and returning a boolean if it is at least two. Write a helper to categorize square feet taking an integer which can be absent and returning a string or missing. Write a helper to assess lot size taking an integer which can be absent and returning a string or missing. Output is a list with main street.

title: Recipe finder
spec: Find recipes matching dietary needs. The entry function `find(recipes)` receives a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string name, an integer maximum time which can be missing, a string dietary restriction which can be missing, a string cuisine which can be missing, and a string primary ingredient which can be missing. Define a recipe class with these optional fields. Write a helper to classify the time taking an integer which can be missing returning a string like quick or slow or missing. Write a helper to check the restriction taking a string which can be missing returning a boolean if it is vegan. Write a helper to format cuisine taking a string which can be missing returning a capitalized string or missing. Write a helper to validate the ingredient taking a string which can be missing returning a lowercased string or missing. The main function returns a list of names for recipes that are vegan and have a classified time. Input is salad, ten, vegan, missing, lettuce. Output is a list containing salad.

title: Music track search
spec: Filter a digital music library. The entry function `search(tracks)` takes a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string title, a string artist which might be absent, a string album which might be absent, a string genre which might be absent, and an integer release year which might be absent. Output is a list with bohemian rhapsody.

title: Job posting filter
spec: Match job seekers with open positions. The entry function `match(jobs)` accepts a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string job title, an integer salary which can be missing, a string location which can be missing, a string job type which can be missing, and a string experience level which can be missing. title: Hotel room search

Each tuple has a string room number, an integer beds which might be missing, a string view which might be missing, a string balcony type which might be missing, and a string smoking policy which might be missing. title: Space mission log

title: Restaurant reservation system
spec: Manage dining reservations. The entry function `manage(reservations)` accepts a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string customer name, a string special request which can be missing, a string seating preference which can be missing, a string occasion which can be missing, and a string allergy which can be missing. title: Linked list operations
spec: Implement a singly linked list for text strings. The entry function `process(words)` takes a list of strings, builds a linked list, and extracts the string values of nodes that meet a condition. First define a node class with a string value and a next node which might be missing. Write a helper to append a new string to a node which might be missing, returning the head node which might be missing. The main function builds the list by appending all words starting from a missing head, reverses it, and returns the string value of the new head node. If input is apple, banana, cherry, the output is cherry.

title: Configuration parser
spec: Parse application settings. The entry function `parse(configs)` receives a list of tuples representing raw configuration lines. Each tuple has a string key, an integer timeout which might be absent, a string environment which might be absent, an integer retries which might be absent, and a string log level which might be absent. title: File system path resolver
spec: Resolve file paths based on partial data. The entry function `resolve(paths)` takes a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string filename, a string parent directory which can be missing, a string file extension which can be missing, an integer file size which can be missing, and a string owner which can be missing. Write a helper to check if the owner is root taking a string which can be missing returning a boolean. The main function returns a list of filenames that have a standardized extension and are not owned by root. Input is script, home, py, one thousand, user. Output is a list with script.

title: Pagination metadata extractor
spec: Process API pagination metadata. The entry function `extract(pages)` takes a list of tuples. Each tuple has an integer current page, an integer next page which might be absent, an integer previous page which might be absent, an integer total count which might be absent, and a string page token which might be absent. title: Text search constraints

Input is hello world, hello, zero, five, insensitive. Output is a list with hello world.

title: Course enrollment tracker
spec: Track student enrollments. The entry function `track(students)` takes a list of tuples. Each tuple has a string student name, a string major which might be absent, an integer graduation year which might be absent, a string advisor name which might be absent, and a string minor which might be absent. Define a student class with these optional fields. Write a helper to format the major taking a string which might be absent returning an uppercase string or missing. Write a helper to check if the graduation year is soon taking an integer which might be absent returning a boolean. Write a helper to standardize the advisor name taking a string which might be absent returning a string or missing. Output is a list containing alice.

title: Project Task Prioritization
spec: Create a project management tool to prioritize team tasks. Define a data class for a task containing a title, an optional assignee name, an optional due date, an optional blocking task identifier, an optional external link, and an optional epic name. Write two helper functions: one that takes a task priority level and an optional due date, returning an optional urgent warning string if the date is within three days; and another that takes an optional blocking task and returns an optional delay reason string if the blocker is an active ticket. The main function `prioritize(tasks)` processes a list of tasks and returns a list of delay reason strings or standard strings if neither warning is present. Example: given a task with a title and a blocker, it returns a list containing the delay reason string.

title: Software Bug Triage
spec: Build a system to classify software bug reports. Define a data class for a bug report with a title, an optional reproduction step string, an optional expected behavior, an optional attached screenshot name, an optional operating system, and an optional browser version. Write two helpers: one accepts a title and an optional operating system, returning an optional platform tag string if the operating system name is found within the title; the other takes an optional expected behavior and returns an optional quality score integer based on the string length. The entry function `triage(bugs)` takes a list of bug reports and returns a list of calculated priority scores by adding points for each present optional field, incorporating the quality score if available. Example: given a bug report with only a title and operating system, it returns a list containing the integer priority.

title: Customer Survey Analysis
spec: Analyze customer feedback surveys where many questions are skipped. Define a data class for a survey response containing a primary rating, an optional written comment, an optional demographic age bracket, an optional household income bracket, an optional referral source, and an optional contact email. Write two helpers: one evaluates an optional written comment and an optional contact email, returning an optional follow up priority string if both are present and the comment text includes negative keywords; the other checks an optional age bracket and returns an optional generation label string. The main function `analyze(surveys)` takes a list of responses and returns a list of summary sentences for each survey that requires follow up, including the generation label if known. Example: given a response with a low rating and a complaint comment, it returns a list with one follow up summary sentence.

title: Veterinary Patient Intake
spec: Process admission records for a veterinary clinic. Define a data class for a patient with a species name, an optional breed name, an optional microchip number, an optional dietary restriction, an optional known allergy, and an optional preferred veterinarian. Write two helper functions: one examines an optional microchip number and an optional breed name, returning an optional identification string if the microchip matches a known registry prefix; the other takes an optional allergy and returns an optional medical alert string if the allergy is severe. The main function `admit(patients)` iterates over a list of patients, returning a list of formatted intake sentences combining the species, identification string, and medical alert if applicable. Example: given a cat with no microchip but a known allergy, it outputs a list of one intake sentence mentioning the cat and the medical alert.

title: Employee Directory Import
spec: Format imported employee records for a corporate directory. Define a data class for an employee containing a full name, an optional department name, an optional desk phone number, an optional mobile phone number, an optional manager name, and an optional remote work location. Write two helpers: one accepts an optional desk phone and an optional mobile phone, returning an optional primary contact string by preferring the mobile phone if both are present; the other takes an optional manager name and returns an optional hierarchy string if the manager name belongs to the executive team. The main function `process(employees)` takes a list of employee data classes and returns a list of formatted directory entries, combining the full name, primary contact, and hierarchy string if available. Example: given an employee with a name and a mobile phone, it returns a list with one sentence containing the name and mobile phone.

title: Freight Shipment Routing
spec: Calculate routing instructions for freight shipments. Define a data class for a shipment containing a destination city, an optional intermediate warehouse, an optional hazardous material code, an optional temperature requirement, an optional delivery time window, and an optional customs broker. Write two helper functions: one accepts an optional temperature requirement and an optional hazardous material code, returning an optional special handling string if both indicate a conflict; the other takes an optional intermediate warehouse and returns an optional routing note string if the warehouse name includes a specific keyword. The main function `route(shipments)` processes a list of shipments and returns a list of routing directives combining the destination city with any special handling or routing notes that exist. Example: given a shipment to London with a temperature requirement and hazardous code, it returns a list with one string detailing London and the special handling.

title: Podcast Episode Formatting
spec: Generate display text for podcast episodes in an audio player. Define a data class for an episode with a title, an optional guest name, an optional season number, an optional episode number, an optional sponsor message, and an optional transcript link. Write two helpers: one takes an optional season number and an optional episode number, returning an optional production code string by combining them with a dash if both are numbers; the other takes an optional guest name and returns an optional feature banner string if the guest is recognized. The main function `display(episodes)` processes a list of episodes and returns a list of display strings by appending the production code, feature banner, and sponsor message to the title if present. Example: given an episode with a title and a guest name, it outputs a list with one string combining the title and guest feature banner.

title: Astronomy Observation Log
spec: Catalog astronomical observations from a telescope. Define a data class for an observation containing a celestial coordinates string, an optional constellation name, an optional apparent magnitude, an optional spectral type, an optional companion star identifier, and an optional observer note. Write two helper functions: one takes an optional apparent magnitude and an optional spectral type, returning an optional visibility classification string if the magnitude is below a certain threshold; the other takes an optional constellation name and returns an optional region label string if the constellation is in the northern hemisphere. The main function `catalog(observations)` evaluates a list of observations, returning a list of descriptive sentences that include the visibility classification and region label if they can be determined. Example: given an observation with coordinates and an apparent magnitude, it returns a list with one sentence containing the coordinates and visibility classification.

title: Smart Home Device Status
spec: Aggregate status reports from various smart home sensors. Define a data class for a device status with a device identifier, an optional temperature reading, an optional humidity reading, an optional motion detected timestamp, an optional battery percentage, and an optional firmware version. Write two helpers: one takes an optional temperature reading and an optional humidity reading, returning an optional comfort index float by averaging the two values if both are greater than zero; the other takes an optional battery percentage and returns an optional low battery warning string if the percentage is below twenty. The main function `aggregate(devices)` processes a list of device statuses, returning a list of summary strings reporting the device identifier along with any calculated comfort index and low battery warning. Example: given a device with an identifier and a low battery percentage, it returns a list with one string warning about the battery.

title: Supply Chain Material Tracking
spec: Track raw materials moving through a supply chain. Define a data class for a material batch with a batch identifier, an optional origin country, an optional quality inspection date, an optional quarantine reason, an optional customs clearance date, and an optional destination factory. Write two helper functions: one takes an optional quality inspection date and an optional quarantine reason to return an optional clearance status string if the quarantine reason is absent but an inspection occurred; the other evaluates an optional origin country, returning an optional tariff warning string if the origin is on a restricted list. The entry function `track(batches)` takes a list of material batches and returns a list of action items for batches that have a tariff warning or an unresolved clearance status, using the batch identifier. Example: given a batch with an identifier and an origin country on the restricted list, it returns a list with one action item string.

title: Corporate Expense Validation
spec: Validate employee expense reports for reimbursement. Define a data class for an expense line item containing an amount, an optional merchant name, an optional receipt file path, an optional project billing code, an optional justification note, and an optional meal attendee list. Write two helpers: one takes an expense amount and an optional receipt file path, returning an optional audit warning string if the amount exceeds a limit and the receipt is missing; the other checks an optional meal attendee list, returning an optional policy violation string if the list is empty. The main function `validate(expenses)` takes a list of expense items and returns a list of rejection reasons by aggregating any audit warnings and policy violations for each expense. Example: given an expense with a large amount and no receipt, it returns a list containing one audit warning string.

title: Warehouse Inventory Locator
spec: Generate picking instructions for warehouse workers. Define a data class for an inventory item with a product code, an optional aisle number, an optional shelf letter, an optional bin number, an optional overflow location, and an optional expiration date. Write two helper functions: one takes an optional aisle number and an optional shelf letter, returning an optional primary location string by concatenating them if the aisle is valid; the other takes an optional expiration date and returns an optional priority handling string if the date is within one week. The main function `locate(items)` takes a list of inventory items and returns a list of picking instructions merging the product code, the primary location if valid, and any priority handling note. Example: given an item with a product code and a near expiration date, it outputs a list with one picking instruction highlighting the priority handling.

title: Academic Citation Formatting
spec: Format citations for academic research papers. Define a data class for a reference containing a title, an optional author list, an optional publication year, an optional journal name, an optional volume number, and an optional digital object identifier. Write two helpers: one processes an optional author list and an optional publication year, returning an optional prefix string formatting them together if the year is recent; the other takes an optional journal name and an optional volume number, returning an optional publication context string if the volume is a positive number. The main function `cite(references)` takes a list of references and returns a list of formatted citation strings combining the prefix, title, and publication context, omitting any missing parts. Example: given a reference with a title and an author list, it returns a list with one string containing the prefix and title.

title: Drone Flight Log Analysis
spec: Analyze telemetry logs from autonomous drone flights. Define a data class for a telemetry point with a timestamp, an optional altitude float, an optional global positioning coordinate, an optional wind speed float, an optional obstacle proximity float, and an optional error code. Write two helper functions: one evaluates an optional altitude and an optional wind speed, returning an optional weather warning string if the wind speed exceeds safety thresholds for that altitude; the other takes an optional obstacle proximity and returns an optional collision risk string if the proximity is under two meters. The main function `evaluate(telemetry)` iterates over a list of telemetry points and returns a list of safety alerts including the timestamp and any generated weather warnings or collision risks. Example: given a telemetry point with a high wind speed, it returns a list with one safety alert string.

title: Cryptographic Certificate Parsing
spec: Extract readable information from digital certificates. Define a data class for a certificate containing a serial number, an optional issuer name, an optional expiration timestamp, an optional alternative subject name, an optional revocation status, and an optional signature algorithm. Write two helpers: one checks an optional expiration timestamp and an optional revocation status, returning an optional invalidity reason string if the expiration is in the past or the status is revoked; the other takes an optional issuer name and returns an optional trust level string if the issuer is globally recognized. The main function `parse(certificates)` takes a list of certificates and returns a list of status summaries combining the serial number, trust level, and invalidity reason where applicable. Example: given a certificate with a serial number and an expiration timestamp in the past, it outputs a list with one string stating the invalidity reason.

title: Building Access Control
spec: Monitor badge swipes in a secure facility. Define a data class for an access event with a badge identifier, an optional entry timestamp, an optional exit timestamp, an optional escort badge identifier, an optional restricted zone name, and an optional denial reason. Write two helper functions: one examines an optional entry timestamp and an optional exit timestamp, returning an optional duration float representing minutes spent if both are present; the other takes an optional restricted zone name and an optional escort badge identifier, returning an optional security alert string if the zone is highly restricted but no escort is provided. The main function `monitor(events)` processes a list of access events and returns a list of log entries appending any duration or security alert to the badge identifier. Example: given an event with a restricted zone and no escort, it returns a list with one log entry containing a security alert.

title: Board Game Turn Resolution
spec: Resolve player turns in a complex tabletop roleplaying game. Define a data class for a turn action with a character name, an optional movement distance, an optional target enemy, an optional weapon used, an optional spell cast, and an optional bonus item. Write two helpers: one takes an optional weapon used and an optional target enemy, returning an optional physical damage integer by calculating a base damage plus a weapon modifier if the weapon is known; the other takes an optional spell cast and returns an optional magical effect string if the spell targets an area. The main function `resolve(turns)` evaluates a list of turn actions and returns a list of outcome sentences combining the character name with the physical damage dealt or magical effect produced. Example: given a turn with a character name and a spell cast, it outputs a list with one outcome sentence detailing the magical effect.

The main function `check(readings)` takes a list of tank readings and returns a list of alert messages gathering any chemical imbalances or maintenance requirements for each tank identifier. Example: given a reading with a low filter flow rate, it returns a list with one maintenance alert message.

spec: Write a module with the entry function `search(patents)`. The input is a list of tuples representing patents containing a string application number, string inventor, integer filing year, string classification, string status, and string keyword, where any field except the application number can be missing. Implement a helper to search for a patent by application number returning it or nothing, and a second helper to filter by inventor, filing year, classification, status, and keyword where missing criteria do not restrict the search. Implement a third helper that takes a classification and status to return the patent with the earliest filing year or nothing. The entry function should filter for classification utility and status granted, find the patent with number one, and find the oldest granted utility patent, returning these three results as a tuple. For example, given a list with one patent having number one, classification utility, status granted, and year ninety, the output will contain a list of that patent, the patent itself, and the patent again.

title: Contact Directory Parser
spec: Extract structured information from a list of plain text contact records. Define a data structure to hold the parsed data. The structure must store the first name and last name, along with several optional fields: middle initial, email address, phone number, company name, job title, prefix, suffix, and fax number. The entry function `parse(lines)` receives a list of plain text strings and returns a list of the structured objects. Create dedicated helper routines to extract the email address, phone number, and middle initial from the text, returning nothing if they are absent. Each record will have values for the optional attributes only if the corresponding data is found in the text. For example, providing a string with only a first and last name results in an object where all eight optional fields are empty.

title: Order Fulfillment Router
spec: Evaluate shipping requests to determine how a package should be routed. Define a structure representing a shipping request. The request must track the destination zip code and package weight, as well as several optional attributes: tracking number, signature required flag, insurance value, delivery instructions, gift message, delivery date, discount code, and alternate address. The entry function `route(requests)` processes a list of these structures and returns a list of strings indicating the assigned carrier for each. Create helper logic to determine if premium shipping applies based on the insurance value and delivery date, returning the premium carrier name or nothing if standard shipping is sufficient. Ensure the structure properly handles cases where all optional attributes are absent.

title: Patient Demographic Extractor
spec: Process unstructured clinic intake forms to extract patient demographics. Establish a data model to store the patient details. The model must include the legal first name and last name, plus eight optional details: preferred name, emergency contact phone, allergies list, blood type, height in inches, weight in pounds, prior surgery date, and primary care physician name. The entry function `extract(forms)` takes a list of text blobs and returns a list of the populated data models. Include specific helper operations to locate the height, weight, and blood type within the text, returning empty values when the information is missing. A form mentioning only a legal name will yield a model with all eight optional details left blank.

title: Antique Appraisal Estimator
spec: Estimate the auction value of antique items based on appraisal records. Design a record structure containing the item description and base value, along with several optional properties: manufacturer name, manufacture year, serial number, restoration date, provenance document link, original box included flag, valuation certificate, and damage description. The entry function `estimate(records)` calculates and returns the final estimated value for a list of these records. Implement helper steps that adjust the base value by examining the manufacture year, restoration date, and damage description, returning specific modifier values or nothing if the attributes are not present. An item with only a description and base value will process with no adjustments.

title: Real Estate Lead Processor
spec: Analyze potential buyer profiles to assign them to the appropriate real estate agent. Formulate a buyer profile structure that requires a client name and contact number, but also tracks eight optional preferences: preferred neighborhood, maximum budget, minimum bedrooms, minimum bathrooms, desired move in date, preapproval amount, current home sale needed flag, and assigned agent name. The entry function `assign(profiles)` takes a list of these profiles and returns a list of agent names. Include logic to determine a high priority status by returning a priority score or nothing based on the preapproval amount and maximum budget. If a profile lacks all optional preferences, it should be assigned to a general pool agent.

title: Car Rental Booking Validator
spec: Validate customer requests for vehicle rentals. Construct a rental request object containing the pickup date and vehicle class, plus optional selections: child seat count, gps requested flag, additional driver name, loyalty account number, promotion code, arriving flight number, dropoff location, and insurance tier. The entry function `validate(requests)` processes a list of rental requests and returns a list of total estimated costs. Add helper routines to calculate add on fees for the child seat count, gps requested flag, and additional driver name, returning the fee amount or nothing if the add on is not selected. A request with only the pickup date and vehicle class will simply return the base cost for that vehicle.

title: Job Application Screener
spec: Screen incoming job applications to determine if candidates meet minimum qualifications. Define an application structure storing the applicant name and applied role, alongside optional submitted details: professional network profile link, portfolio website, cover letter text, referral employee name, visa sponsorship required flag, graduation year, notice period in weeks, and salary expectation. The entry function `screen(applications)` reviews a list of applications and returns a list of boolean values indicating whether each candidate passes the initial screen. Create helper rules that evaluate the portfolio website, referral employee name, and graduation year, returning a bonus score or nothing if the detail is omitted. An application with missing optional details should still be evaluated solely on the required fields.

title: Event Venue Inquiry Manager
spec: Assess incoming event inquiries to determine venue suitability. Create an inquiry model that holds the event date and guest count, as well as optional requirements: preferred caterer name, alcohol permit needed flag, audiovisual equipment list, stage requirement description, load in time, teardown time, special lighting requests, and alternative date. The entry function `assess(inquiries)` evaluates a list of inquiries and returns a list of available venue room names. Implement helper checks to determine if specialized staff is needed based on the audiovisual equipment list and stage requirement description, returning the staff role or nothing if standard staff suffices. An inquiry providing only the date and guest count will be assigned a basic room with standard staffing.

title: Subscription Box Customizer
spec: Customize monthly subscription boxes based on user preferences. Model a subscriber profile requiring a customer identifier and base box type, along with optional customization fields: shirt size, shoe size, dietary restriction, preferred primary color, excluded product category, pet type, birthday month, and skin type. The entry function `customize(profiles)` processes a list of subscriber profiles and returns a list of selected item names for each box. Include helper functions to pick clothing items based on shirt size and shoe size, returning the clothing item identifier or nothing if the sizes are not provided. A profile with no optional fields filled out will receive the standard default items for their base box type.

title: Device Repair Assessment
spec: Assess technical support requests for broken devices. Define a request structure recording the customer name and device model, alongside optional diagnostic fields: warranty expiration date, purchase date, device serial number, operating system version, battery health percentage, physical damage description, password provided flag, and recent backup completed flag. The entry function `triage(requests)` processes a list of requests and returns a routing queue name for each. Create helper operations to determine if out of warranty charges apply by returning an estimated repair cost or nothing based on the warranty expiration date and physical damage description. Requests missing all optional diagnostic fields will be routed to the general inspection queue.

title: Grant Application Evaluator
spec: Evaluate grant funding applications for completeness and eligibility. Formulate an application structure tracking the organization name and requested amount, plus optional supporting details: tax exempt identifier, partner organization name, previous grant year, matched funds amount, project website url, evaluation plan description, video pitch link, and board of directors list. The entry function `evaluate(applications)` takes a list of applications and returns a funding recommendation status for each. Implement helper validations to verify historical standing by returning a historical score or nothing based on the previous grant year and matched funds amount. Applications lacking all optional supporting details will receive a pending status requesting more information.

title: Insurance Claim Adjuster
spec: Process automobile insurance claims to calculate preliminary payouts. Design a claim record containing the policyholder name and incident date, with several optional evidence fields: police report number, witness name, witness phone number, third party insurance provider, dashcam footage link, initial repair estimate, medical report summary, and salvage yard location. The entry function `adjust(claims)` computes and returns a list of approved payout amounts based on the provided claims. Build helper logic to extract a fault modifier by reviewing the police report number and dashcam footage link, returning a numerical multiplier or nothing if the evidence is absent. A claim with no optional evidence fields will yield a default minimum payout.

title: Tour Booking System
spec: Organize daily passenger manifests for guided city tours. Create a booking structure requiring the primary guest name and party size, along with optional travel preferences: hotel pickup location, dietary needs description, spoken language preference, mobility restriction notes, promotional discount code, travel agent identifier, departing flight time, and emergency contact phone. The entry function `organize(bookings)` accepts a list of bookings and returns a formatted manifest list. Include helper steps to schedule special transport by returning a vehicle type or nothing based on the hotel pickup location and mobility restriction notes. Bookings containing only the required fields will be assigned standard meeting points and default transport.

title: Cargo Ship Loading Planner
spec: Plan deck locations for cargo containers. Define a container model storing the cargo weight and destination port, plus optional logistical parameters: hazardous material class, refrigeration temperature, customs broker name, port of entry, security seal number, container size, overweight permit number, and delivery time window. The entry function `plan(containers)` evaluates a list of containers and returns a list of designated deck zone identifiers. Develop helper routines to check regulatory compliance by returning a clearance code or nothing based on the hazardous material class and customs broker name. A container omitting all optional parameters will be assigned to a standard lower deck zone.

title: Gym Membership Contract
spec: Activate new fitness center memberships and assign facility access. Establish a membership structure with the member name and home club location, alongside optional perks: locker number, assigned personal trainer name, towel service flag, parking permit number, corporate sponsor name, student identifier, referral bonus amount, and initiation fee waived flag. The entry function `activate(memberships)` takes a list of memberships and returns a list of access card clearance levels. Implement helper functions to assign premium access zones by returning a zone code or nothing based on the locker number and assigned personal trainer name. Memberships without any optional perks will receive basic gym floor access.

title: Software License Generator
spec: Generate digital license keys for commercial software products. Formulate a license request object containing the customer email and product edition, plus optional constraints: hardware identifier, expiration date, maximum concurrent users, support tier level, custom feature flags, reseller identifier, trial extension days, and designated cloud region. The entry function `generate(requests)` processes a list of license requests and returns a list of encrypted key strings. Create helper logic to embed usage limits by returning a limit payload or nothing based on the expiration date and maximum concurrent users. Requests lacking optional constraints will generate perpetual, unrestricted license keys for the specified edition.

title: Conference Submission Reviewer
spec: Score academic paper submissions for an upcoming technology conference. Model a submission structure that tracks the paper title and primary author, along with optional academic materials: artifact download url, dataset repository link, source code repository, financial disclosure statement, supplementary appendix pdf, rebuttal document text, preferred presentation format, and student author flag. The entry function `score(submissions)` evaluates a list of submissions and returns a list of numerical scores. Include helper evaluations to award reproducibility bonus points by returning a point value or nothing based on the dataset repository link and source code repository. Submissions with no optional academic materials will receive a baseline score based solely on the required fields.

title: Credit Card Application
spec: Underwrite consumer credit card applications to determine credit limits. Design an application format capturing the applicant legal name and annual income, plus optional financial data: middle name, previous residential address, employer phone number, secondary income amount, co applicant name, co applicant annual income, balance transfer requested amount, and promotional interest rate code. The entry function `underwrite(applications)` receives a list of applications and returns a list of approved credit limits. Develop helper steps to calculate debt capacity by returning an additional limit amount or nothing based on the secondary income amount and co applicant annual income. An application missing all optional financial data will be evaluated for a standard starting limit.

title: Online Course Certificate
spec: Generate digital completion certificates for online education platforms. Define a learner record requiring the student name and course title, alongside optional academic achievements: completion date, honors distinction level, supervising instructor name, external verification url, partner university name, final percentage grade, capstone project title, and continuing education units awarded. The entry function `certify(records)` accepts a list of learner records and returns a list of formatted certificate text blocks. Implement helper routines to append special endorsements by returning an endorsement string or nothing based on the honors distinction level and capstone project title. Records without optional achievements will generate a standard certificate of participation.

title: Pet Adoption Application
spec: Review adoption applications to match shelter animals with permanent homes. Create an applicant model containing the adopter name and desired species, plus optional household details: current veterinarian name, landlord contact phone, previous pet history description, fenced yard square footage, preferred specific breed, age preference category, required temperament, and existing microchip number. The entry function `review(applicants)` reviews a list of applicants and returns a list of recommended animal names. Build helper functions to verify outdoor safety by returning a safety rating or nothing based on the fenced yard square footage and landlord contact phone. Applicants leaving all optional household details blank will be recommended low maintenance indoor animals.

title: Wedding RSVP Parser
spec: Process digital response cards to coordinate wedding reception logistics. Formulate a response structure tracking the guest name and attending status, along with optional event preferences: plus one guest name, dinner meal choice, dietary restriction notes, arrival flight details, departure flight details, reception song request, booked hotel block name, and welcome dinner attendance flag. The entry function `process(responses)` takes a list of responses and returns a summary total of expected guests and meals. Create helper logic to flag travel coordination needs by returning a shuttle time or nothing based on the arrival flight details and booked hotel block name. Responses containing only the required fields will be counted for standard attendance with a default meal.

title: Scholarship Eligibility Checker
spec: Determine student eligibility for various university scholarships. Design a student profile holding the student name and current grade point average, plus optional merit and need based attributes: standardized test score, submitted essay text, first recommendation letter, second recommendation letter, completed volunteer hours, household annual income, first generation college student flag, and intended academic major. The entry function `determine(profiles)` evaluates a list of student profiles and returns a list of matched scholarship fund names. Implement helper checks to assess community service by returning a service tier or nothing based on the completed volunteer hours and submitted essay text. Profiles missing all optional attributes will only be considered for basic academic merit awards.

title: Concert Ticket Upgrade
spec: Process attendee ticket upgrades for a live music event. Model a ticket record requiring the ticket holder name and section assignment, alongside optional premium add ons: vip lounge pass, backstage access flag, reserved parking pass, merchandise voucher amount, complimentary drink ticket count, artist meet and greet time, special expedited entrance, and commemorative lanyard flag. The entry function `upgrade(tickets)` takes a list of ticket records and returns a list of final ticket prices. Include helper operations to calculate premium package fees by returning an extra cost or nothing based on the backstage access flag and artist meet and greet time. Tickets with no optional premium add ons will remain at the base section price.

title: Freelance Contract Generator
spec: Draft customized legal agreements for independent contractors. Establish a contract parameters structure with the contractor name and hourly rate, plus optional legal clauses: client company name, signatory corporate title, termination notice days, non compete duration clause, governing jurisdiction state, alternative dispute arbitration city, late payment fee percentage, and upfront deposit amount. The entry function `draft(parameters)` processes a list of contract parameters and returns a list of final agreement text documents. Build helper steps to formulate standard termination language by returning a text paragraph or nothing based on the termination notice days and governing jurisdiction state. Parameters lacking all optional legal clauses will generate a simple default agreement.

title: Autonomous Delivery Waypoint Planner
spec: Calculate optimal flight paths for autonomous delivery drones. Define a waypoint objective containing the destination coordinates and package weight, along with optional flight constraints: maximum altitude limit, restricted airspace avoidance zone, preferred flight speed, noise reduction requirement flag, weather condition override, secondary landing zone, battery reserve percentage, and visual tracking identifier. The entry function `navigate(objectives)` evaluates a list of waypoint objectives and returns a list of calculated flight times. Implement helper routines to adjust the trajectory for safety by returning an altitude modification or nothing based on the maximum altitude limit and restricted airspace avoidance zone. Objectives with no optional flight constraints will use the most direct path at standard cruising speed.

title: Historical Artifact Categorizer
spec: Write a function `categorize(artifacts)` that takes a list of historical item records and processes them. Each artifact is an object holding a description string, an origin country string, an estimated creation year integer, a material string, and a condition score float. All fields except the description can be missing. Write a helper function that takes the year and origin to calculate a historical significance integer, returning a missing value if either is absent. Write another helper that evaluates the material and condition score to determine a preservation strategy string, returning a missing value if the condition is missing. The main function must return a list of processed records where missing origins are replaced by unknown, and missing condition scores are replaced by zero. Example input: an artifact with description crown, origin missing, year 1500, material gold, condition missing. Output: a list containing the artifact with origin updated to unknown and condition to zero.

title: Spacecraft Telemetry Filter
spec: Create an entry point `monitor(telemetry)` that receives a sequence of telemetry readings from a satellite. Each reading contains a timestamp integer, a temperature float, a pressure float, a velocity float, and an error code integer. The temperature, pressure, velocity, and error code can be missing due to sensor dropouts. Create a helper function that takes the temperature and pressure to calculate a stability score float, returning a missing value if either is absent. Create another helper to check the velocity and error code against safety thresholds, returning a missing value if velocity is absent. The main function returns a list of alerts for readings where the stability score is below fifty or the safety check fails. Example input: a reading with timestamp one, temperature twenty, pressure missing, velocity five, error code missing. Output: a list containing the timestamp one.

title: Refugee Aid Prioritization
spec: Implement `prioritize(refugees)` to sort a list of asylum seeker profiles based on need. A profile includes a name string, an age integer, a family size integer, a medical condition string, and an origin city string. Age, family size, medical condition, and origin city might be missing from the records. Write a helper function that takes the medical condition and origin city and returns a risk score integer, or a missing value if the condition is not provided. Write another helper that estimates priority points from age and family size, returning a missing value if both are missing. The main function should update each profile with the calculated priority score, substituting zero where helpers return missing values, and return the sorted list of profiles. Example input: name John, age thirty, family size missing, medical condition missing, origin missing. Output: list with John having a score of zero.

title: Plant Disease Classifier
spec: Design `classify(plants)` to assess a list of plant inspection reports. Each report is represented as an object with a species string, a leaf discoloration string, a stem damage severity integer, a root rot score float, and a soil acidity float. The discoloration, stem damage, root rot score, and soil acidity are often missing. Develop a helper function that evaluates the leaf discoloration and soil acidity, returning a disease name string or a missing value if either is missing. Develop another helper that combines stem damage and root rot into a critical health index float, returning a missing value if either is absent. The main function must return a list of tuples containing the species and the identified disease, using healthy if the disease name is missing. Example input: a plant with species rose, discoloration missing, stem damage two, root rot missing, acidity missing. Output: a list containing a tuple of rose and healthy.

title: Used Vehicle Evaluator
spec: Write a procedure `evaluate(vehicles)` that takes a collection of vehicle inspection summaries. A vehicle summary holds a model name string, a mileage integer, a previous accidents integer, a spare tire presence boolean, and a service manual presence boolean. All fields except the model name can be missing. Include a helper function that takes the mileage and accidents to calculate a wear factor float, returning a missing value if either piece of data is missing. Create a second helper that assesses completeness based on the spare tire and service manual, returning a missing value if both are missing. The main procedure returns a list of vehicle models that have a wear factor below five and a true completeness assessment, assuming missing values mean failure. Example input: model sedan, mileage fifty thousand, accidents missing, tire missing, manual missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Fossil Excavation Analyzer
spec: Construct `analyze(fossils)` to process data from a paleontological dig. Each fossil record contains an identifier string, an estimated period string, a depth float, a bone fragment count integer, and a soil type string. The period, depth, bone count, and soil type can all be missing. Write a helper function that deduces the exact era string from the depth and soil type, returning a missing value if either is missing. Write another helper that assesses completeness from the bone fragment count and period, returning a missing value if the count is absent. The main routine should return a list of identifiers for fossils that have a known era and a completeness assessment above ten, ignoring those with missing completeness. Example input: identifier skull, period missing, depth ten, bone count missing, soil missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Telescope Observation Validator
spec: Implement `validate(observations)` to clean up astronomical logs. An observation comprises a target name string, a right ascension float, a declination float, an apparent magnitude float, and an observer name string. The coordinates, magnitude, and observer can be missing due to incomplete logging. Create a helper function that takes right ascension and declination to compute a celestial sector integer, returning a missing value if either coordinate is missing. Create another helper to categorize the brightness based on apparent magnitude and observer name, returning a missing value if magnitude is not provided. The main function should return a list of valid target names where both the sector and brightness category are successfully calculated. Example input: target moon, coordinates missing, magnitude missing, observer missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Recipe Substitute Generator
spec: Develop `substitute(recipes)` to suggest alternatives for cooking instructions. Each recipe component has an original ingredient string, a primary alternative string, a secondary alternative string, a flavor profile string, and an allergy warning string. Everything except the original ingredient can be missing. Write a helper function to select the best alternative by preferring the primary over the secondary, returning a missing value if both are missing. Write a second helper that assesses the safety level string using the allergy warning and flavor profile, returning a missing value if the allergy warning is missing. The main function returns a list of tuples with the original ingredient and the safe alternative, skipping those where no safe alternative exists. Example input: original milk, primary missing, secondary water, flavor missing, allergy missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Mineral Property Classifier
spec: Create `classify(minerals)` to categorize geological samples based on field tests. A mineral record includes a sample name string, a streak color string, a hardness score float, a cleavage plane integer, and a fracture type string. The streak color, hardness, cleavage, and fracture can all be missing if tests were not performed. Write a helper function that evaluates the hardness and cleavage to determine a durability class string, returning a missing value if either is missing. Write another helper that uses the streak color and fracture type to guess the metallic content boolean, returning a missing value if the streak is missing. The main function should gather all minerals that have a known durability class and are guessed to be metallic, returning their sample names. Example input: sample quartz, streak missing, hardness seven, cleavage missing, fracture missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Emergency Dispatch Router
spec: Implement `route(calls)` to handle incoming emergency requests. A call consists of a caller name string, an exact address string, a callback number string, a medical emergency boolean, and a police requirement boolean. Any of these fields except the caller name can be missing. Create a helper function to determine the priority level integer based on the medical and police flags, returning a missing value if both are missing. Create another helper to format the dispatch location using the address and callback number, returning a missing value if the address is missing. The main function must return a list of dispatch instructions containing the caller name and location, but only for calls that have a high priority level. Example input: caller Alice, address missing, callback missing, medical true, police missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Art Restoration Estimator
spec: Write `estimate(artworks)` to evaluate paintings for conservation. An artwork contains a title string, an original paint type string, a damage severity integer, a previous restorer string, and a completion date string. All fields except the title might be missing. Write a helper function to calculate the estimated repair hours integer based on paint type and damage severity, returning a missing value if either is missing. Write another helper to determine if historical context is needed boolean based on the previous restorer and completion date, returning a missing value if both are missing. The main routine should return a list of titles for artworks that require more than ten repair hours and need historical context. Example input: title portrait, paint missing, damage five, restorer missing, date missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Animal Rescue Processor
spec: Design `process(animals)` to organize shelter admissions. An intake record has a name string, a breed string, an age float, a microchip number string, and a surrender reason string. The breed, age, microchip, and reason can be missing. Develop a helper function to assign a care ward string based on age and breed, returning a missing value if age is missing. Develop another helper that checks the microchip and surrender reason against a registry, returning a registration status boolean or a missing value if the microchip is absent. The main function returns a list of tuples containing the animal name and assigned ward, falling back to a general ward if the helper returns a missing value. Example input: name buddy, breed missing, age missing, microchip missing, reason missing. Output: a list with a tuple of buddy and general.

title: Cyber Incident Correlator
spec: Construct `correlate(incidents)` to analyze security logs. An incident object holds an event identifier string, an attacker address string, a compromised port integer, a malware hash string, and a data exfiltration size float. The address, port, hash, and size can be missing. Write a helper function that evaluates the threat severity integer using the compromised port and exfiltration size, returning a missing value if both are missing. Write a second helper that categorizes the attack vector string based on the attacker address and malware hash, returning a missing value if the hash is missing. The main function processes a list of incidents, returning a list of event identifiers that have a high threat severity and a known attack vector. Example input: event alpha, address missing, port eighty, hash missing, size missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Weather Balloon Aggregator
spec: Create `aggregate(readings)` to summarize atmospheric data. A balloon reading includes a timestamp string, a humidity float, a wind speed float, an ozone level float, and a solar radiation float. The humidity, wind speed, ozone, and radiation can be missing due to instrument failure. Create a helper function to calculate the chill factor float from solar radiation and wind speed, returning a missing value if wind speed is missing. Create another helper to assess atmospheric density from humidity and ozone, returning a missing value if either is missing. The main function should yield a list of timestamps where the chill factor is below freezing and the density is successfully assessed. Example input: timestamp noon, humidity missing, wind speed fifty, ozone missing, radiation missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Dental Record Analyzer
spec: Implement `analyze(patients)` to review clinic histories. A patient profile contains a patient name string, a previous dentist string, an x-ray date string, an insurance provider string, and a copay amount float. The previous dentist, x-ray date, insurance, and copay can all be missing. Write a helper function to determine if a new x-ray is required based on the x-ray date and previous dentist, returning a missing value if the date is absent. Write another helper to calculate the out of pocket cost based on the insurance and copay, returning a missing value if both are missing. The main function should return a list of patient names who definitely need a new x-ray and have a known out of pocket cost. Example input: name charlie, dentist missing, date missing, insurance missing, copay missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Orphaned Package Router
spec: Develop `route(packages)` to handle mail with incomplete labels. A package record has a tracking code string, a recipient name string, a return address string, a zip code integer, and a weight class string. The recipient, return address, zip code, and weight class can be missing. Write a helper function to infer the destination region string from the zip code and recipient name, returning a missing value if the zip code is missing. Write another helper to estimate the postage due float from the weight class and return address, returning a missing value if the weight is missing. The main function should process the packages and return a list of tuples containing the tracking code and the destination region, using a holding facility if the region is missing. Example input: tracking alpha, recipient missing, address missing, zip missing, weight missing. Output: a list containing a tuple of alpha and holding facility.

title: Dialogue Tree Resolver
spec: Write `resolve(dialogues)` to process conversational nodes in a game engine. A dialogue node comprises a node identifier string, a required item string, a relationship threshold integer, a text prompt string, and a fallback response string. The item, threshold, text prompt, and fallback can be missing. Create a helper function that verifies if the player meets the requirements using the item and threshold, returning a missing value if both are absent. Create a second helper to determine the exact display text by choosing the text prompt or the fallback response, returning a missing value if the text prompt is missing. The main function evaluates each dialogue node and returns a list of node identifiers for nodes where the requirements are met and the display text is successfully determined. Example input: identifier start, item missing, threshold missing, text hello, fallback missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Ocean Buoy Monitor
spec: Design `monitor(buoys)` to track marine conditions. A buoy transmission includes a station identifier string, a salinity float, a wave height float, a water temperature float, and a battery level float. The salinity, wave height, temperature, and battery can be missing. Develop a helper function to calculate the ocean turbulence index float from wave height and temperature, returning a missing value if either is absent. Develop another helper that checks if a maintenance team should be dispatched based on the battery level and salinity, returning a missing value if the battery is missing. The main function must return a list of station identifiers that have a turbulence index above five or definitely require maintenance. Example input: station one, salinity missing, wave height missing, temperature missing, battery missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Furniture Order Processor
spec: Construct `process(orders)` to manage carpentry requests. An order object has a customer name string, a wood type string, a finish stain string, a cushion fabric string, and an engraved text string. The wood type, stain, fabric, and text can be missing. Write a helper function to calculate the material cost float based on the wood type and fabric, returning a missing value if the wood type is missing. Write a second helper to determine the estimated production time integer from the stain and engraved text, returning a missing value if both are missing. The main routine should return a list of tuples containing the customer name and material cost, filtering out orders where the production time cannot be estimated. Example input: name bob, wood oak, stain missing, fabric missing, text missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Manuscript Transcription Parser
spec: Create `parse(manuscripts)` to format historical texts. A manuscript record contains a folio identifier string, a translator name string, a regional dialect string, a page count integer, and an illumination description string. The translator, dialect, page count, and illumination can be missing. Create a helper function to classify the text complexity string based on the dialect and page count, returning a missing value if the page count is missing. Create another helper to generate a visual summary from the illumination description and translator name, returning a missing value if the description is absent. The main function should process all manuscripts, returning a list of folio identifiers that have a known text complexity and a generated visual summary. Example input: folio one, translator missing, dialect missing, page count missing, illumination missing. Output: an empty list.

title: Traffic Incident Assessor
spec: Implement `assess(incidents)` to evaluate road safety reports. An incident record has an intersection name string, a weather condition string, a road surface state string, a witness statement string, and a police badge number string. The weather, surface state, witness, and badge can all be missing. Write a helper function to calculate a visibility penalty integer based on the weather condition and road surface state, returning a missing value if the weather is missing. title: Cave Cheese Aging Monitor

title: Plumbing Layout Flow Assessor
spec: Create an entry function `assess(pipes, diameter, pressure, length)`. The pipes list provides tuples of segment id, internal diameter, pressure rating, and segment length. title: Sourdough Proofing Evaluator

title: Artisanal Candle Wax Assessor
spec: Create an entry function `pour(batches, melt, fragrance, thickness)`. The batches list carries tuples of batch id, melt point temperature, fragrance load percentage, and wick thickness. title: Ceramic Kiln Firing Monitor

title: Bonsai Tree Pruning Simulator
spec: Design a system to simulate bonsai tree pruning. Create a class representing a branch, initialized with an integer length. title: Escape Room Puzzle Graph
spec: Model an escape room puzzle graph. Define a room class initialized with an integer room identifier. Implement a helper routine that accepts a room and searches it and its immediate neighbors for a specific key item string, returning the room containing it or nothing. It returns the integer identifier of the room with the key, or zero if it is missing. For example, finding a room with the gold key returns identifier 42, while finding nothing returns 0.

title: Train Yard Shunting Sequence
spec: Simulate a train yard shunting process. Create a train car class starting with an integer car number. It tracks a front car connection, a back car connection, a cargo description string, and a destination city string, all of which might be absent. spec: Build a tracer for a neon sign circuit. Construct a glass tube segment class requiring an integer segment length.
