The entry function `inspect(tower)` locates the lowest foundation. If found and it has a flag, it returns the flag color, otherwise it returns an empty string. For example, a foundation flag might return red, or an empty string if there is no flag.

title: Fireworks Choreography Sequence
spec: Choreograph a fireworks display sequence. Build a pyrotechnic shell class starting with an integer delay time. It can contain an inner shell, an outer shell, a trail color string, and a secondary burst pattern string, all of which might be absent. Implement a helper function that extracts the trail color of the inner shell, returning the string or nothing. Add another helper that follows outer shells outward to locate the outermost shell, returning it or nothing. The main entry function `ignite(shell)` gathers the trail colors from the given shell and up to two levels of inner shells. It returns a list of these colors, simply omitting any that are absent. For example, nested shells might return a list of colors like blue, red, and gold.

title: Tapestry Weaving Draft Analyzer
spec: Analyze a tapestry weaving draft. Create a knot class initialized with an integer tension level. It connects to a left thread knot, a right thread knot, a bead material string, and a metallic wrap style string, all of which might be absent. Provide a helper function that checks the left thread and its subsequent left thread for a glass bead, returning the knot that holds it or nothing. Write a second helper that retrieves the metallic wrap style of the right thread knot, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `weave(knot)` evaluates the current knot and its immediate left and right neighbors, returning a list of their metallic wrap styles and skipping any knots or styles that are absent. For example, missing threads could yield a wrap style list containing only silver.

title: Roller Coaster Layout Mapper
spec: Map a roller coaster layout. Define a track segment class requiring an integer pitch angle. It connects to a next segment, a previous segment, a brake type string, and a launch speed integer, all of which might be absent. Implement a helper function that traces forward along next segments until a segment with brakes is found, returning that segment or nothing. Add another helper that looks backward to find a launch speed integer, returning the integer or nothing. The entry function `ride(segment)` uses these helpers to return a tuple containing the next brake type and the previous launch speed, substituting an empty string and a zero respectively if they are absent. For example, finding magnetic brakes and a launch speed of 60 returns the tuple of magnetic and 60.

title: Fountain Water Display Controller
spec: Control a fountain water display sequence. Construct a water jet class starting with an integer water pressure. It links to a main nozzle jet, a secondary nozzle jet, a light color string, and a music cue string, all of which might be absent. Create a helper function that searches the main and secondary nozzles for a blue light, returning the matching jet or nothing. Provide a second helper that extracts the music cue from the main nozzle jet, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `splash(jet)` compiles a list of light colors from the jet itself, its main nozzle, and its secondary nozzle, skipping any nozzles or colors that are absent, and returns the list. For example, compiling the lights might produce a list containing blue and green.

title: Puppet String Manipulator
spec: Animate a puppet through a string manipulator model. Define a marionette joint class initialized with an integer joint angle. It maintains references to a parent joint, a left child joint, a right child joint, and a control string name, all of which might be absent. Write a helper function that ascends the parent joints to find the highest joint in the hierarchy, returning it or nothing if it is already the top. Develop another helper that checks the left and right children for a specific control string name, returning the matching joint or nothing. The entry function `animate(joint)` returns a tuple of the original joint angle and the string name of its highest parent, substituting an empty string if no string exists. For example, a joint angle of 45 and a missing string returns the tuple (45, "").

title: Terrarium Ecosystem Balancer
spec: Monitor a terrarium ecosystem hierarchy. Create a soil layer class requiring an integer moisture level. It connects to a layer above, a layer below, an insect species string, and a root type string, all of which might be absent. Implement a helper function that digs downward through layers to find one containing roots, returning the layer or nothing. Write another helper that checks the layer directly above for an insect species, returning the species string or nothing. The entry function `balance(layer)` utilizes these helpers to return a tuple of the moisture level of the layer with roots and the insect species from above, using zero and an empty string if they are absent. For example, finding root layer moisture of 80 and no insect returns the tuple (80, "").

title: Clockwork Automaton Gear Tracer
spec: Simulate clockwork automaton gears. Build a cog class initialized with an integer tooth count. It tracks a driving cog, a driven cog, a cam shape string, and a spring tension integer, all of which might be absent. Provide a helper function that traces backward through driving cogs to find the first one equipped with a spring, returning the cog or nothing. Create a second helper that retrieves the cam shape of the driven cog, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `wind(cog)` calculates the sum of the tooth counts of the provided cog and its immediate driving cog if one is present, returning the integer sum. For example, cogs with 20 and 40 teeth return a sum of 60.

title: Parachute Rigging Line Inspector
spec: Inspect parachute rigging lines. Define a suspension line class starting with an integer line strength. It references a canopy attachment line, a harness attachment line, a toggle color string, and a slider ring material string, all of which might be absent. Implement a helper function that follows canopy attachments upward to find a toggle, returning the line containing it or nothing. Write another helper that retrieves the slider ring material of the harness attachment line, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `verify(line)` returns a tuple of the toggle color and slider material discovered by these helpers, using empty strings as fallbacks when absent. For example, missing slider materials yield the tuple with yellow and an empty string.

title: Stained Glass Window Assembly
spec: Assemble a stained glass window. Construct a glass pane class requiring an integer pane thickness. It links to a top neighbor pane, a bottom neighbor pane, a painted detail string, and a lead profile string, all of which might be absent. Create a helper function that ascends through top neighbors to find the uppermost pane, returning it or nothing if it is already at the top. Provide another helper that checks if the bottom neighbor pane features a painted detail, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `glaze(pane)` gathers the lead profiles from the current pane and its immediate top and bottom neighbors, returning a list of strings while skipping any absent panes or profiles. For example, an assembly might return lead profiles containing flat and rounded.

title: Carousel Horse Figure Restorer
spec: Restore carousel animal figures. Define a carousel figure class initialized with an integer age in years. It holds references to a front figure, a rear figure, an inner ring figure, and a brass pole shape string, all of which might be absent. Implement a helper function that steps through rear figures to find the first one featuring a brass pole, returning the figure or nothing. Add a second helper that retrieves the brass pole shape of the inner ring figure, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `restore(figure)` returns a list of ages for the current figure and its immediate front and rear neighbors, substituting zero for any neighbor that is absent. For example, neighboring ages might produce the list of 100, 0, and 95.

title: Scuba Dive Profile Analyzer
spec: Analyze a scuba dive profile. Build a dive stop class starting with an integer depth in meters. It connects to a previous stop, a next stop, a breathing gas string, and a thermocline description string, all of which might be absent. Write a helper function that follows next stops downward to find the deepest stop, returning the stop or nothing if there are no subsequent stops. Develop another helper that checks the previous stop for a breathing gas, returning the gas string or nothing. The entry function `dive(stop)` returns a tuple containing the deepest stop depth and the previous breathing gas, substituting zero and an empty string respectively if they are absent. For example, a maximum depth of 30 and no gas recorded returns the tuple (30, "").

title: Typography Font Kerning Calculator
spec: Calculate typography font kerning. Create a glyph class requiring an integer advance width. It references a left neighbor glyph, a right neighbor glyph, a ligature replacement string, and a kerning offset integer, all of which might be absent. Provide a helper function that checks the right neighbor and its subsequent right neighbor for a ligature replacement, returning the matching glyph or nothing. Write a second helper that retrieves the kerning offset of the left neighbor, returning the integer or nothing. The entry function `kern(glyph)` computes the total advance width of the current glyph and its left and right neighbors, returning the integer sum by substituting zero for absent neighbors. For example, advance widths of 500, 600, and an absent neighbor yield a total of 1100.

title: Knitting Loom Pattern Processor
spec: Process a knitting loom pattern. Define a loom peg class initialized with an integer tension value. It links to a clockwise peg, a counterclockwise peg, an active yarn color string, and a stitch marker string, all of which might be absent. Implement a helper function that searches the clockwise direction for a peg holding a stitch marker, returning the peg or nothing. Add another helper that retrieves the active yarn color of the counterclockwise peg, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `knit(peg)` uses these helpers to return a tuple of the discovered stitch marker and yarn color, substituting empty strings as fallbacks when absent. For example, missing active yarns produce a tuple containing the marker and an empty string.

title: Submarine Sonar Ping Interpreter
spec: Interpret a submarine sonar ping. Construct a ping reflection class starting with an integer signal strength. It tracks a primary echo reflection, a secondary echo reflection, an identified vessel string, and a seabed anomaly string, all of which might be absent. Create a helper function that follows primary echoes to locate an identified vessel, returning the reflection or nothing. Provide a second helper that retrieves the seabed anomaly of the secondary echo reflection, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `ping(reflection)` compiles a list of identified vessel strings from the current reflection, its primary echo, and its secondary echo, simply omitting any absent reflections or strings. For example, reflections might yield vessel strings like submarine and whale.

title: Embroidery Stitch Path Tracer
spec: Trace an embroidery stitch path. Build a stitch node class requiring an integer stitch length. It references a previous stitch node, a next stitch node, a thread color string, and a tension adjustment string, all of which might be absent. Write a helper function that traces backward through previous stitches to find a thread color change, returning the node or nothing. Develop another helper that checks the next stitch node for a tension adjustment, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `stitch(node)` collects the stitch lengths for the current, previous, and next stitches, returning a list of these lengths while substituting zero for any stitches that are absent. For example, lengths of the current and missing next stitch might yield a list like 5, 0, and 7.

title: Audio Synthesizer Patch Router
spec: Route an audio synthesizer patch. Define a synthesizer module class initialized with an integer frequency. It connects to an input source module, an output destination module, a modulation envelope string, and a filter type string, all of which might be absent. Implement a helper function that follows output destinations to find a module with a filter type, returning the module or nothing. Add another helper that retrieves the modulation envelope of the input source module, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `synthesize(module)` returns a tuple of the discovered filter type and input modulation envelope, substituting empty strings if they are absent. For example, finding a lowpass filter and a missing envelope returns the tuple containing lowpass and an empty string.

title: Magic Trick Deck Stack Simulator
spec: Simulate a magic trick deck stack. Create a stacked card class starting with an integer card value. It references a card above, a card below, a marked edge string, and a secret bend string, all of which might be absent. Provide a helper function that searches downward through the deck to find a card with a secret bend, returning the card or nothing. Write a second helper that checks the card immediately above for a marked edge, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `shuffle(card)` gathers the card values for the current card, the card above, and the card below, returning a list of these integers and substituting zero for any absent cards. For example, card values from the stack might return a list containing 10, 11, and 0.

title: Mine Shaft Lift Operator
spec: Operate a mine shaft lift system. Construct a lift level class requiring an integer depth. It tracks an upward level node, a downward level node, a waiting miner string, and a hazard alert string, all of which might be absent. Create a helper function that searches upward through the levels to find one with a waiting miner, returning the level node or nothing. Provide another helper that checks the downward level for a hazard alert, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `hoist(level)` returns a tuple of the waiting miner name and the hazard alert string found by the helpers, substituting empty strings if they are absent. For example, finding miner John and no hazard yields a tuple of John and an empty string.

title: Ski Resort Trail Status Monitor
spec: Monitor ski resort trail conditions. Define a ski trail class initialized with an integer steepness grade. It connects to an uphill trail, a downhill trail, a snowmaking status string, and a hazard warning string, all of which might be absent. Implement a helper function that traces downhill trails to find the lowest base trail, returning it or nothing if no downhill trails exist. Add another helper that retrieves the hazard warning of the uphill trail connection, returning the string or nothing. The entry function `ski(trail)` returns a tuple of the lowest trail's snowmaking status and the uphill hazard warning, substituting empty strings if either trail or string is absent. For example, a base trail with active snowmaking and a missing hazard returns a tuple of active and an empty string.

title: Analog camera valuation
spec: Define a data structure for a camera storing a model name string, and five values that can be absent: a production year integer, a lens focal length integer, a condition description string, a light meter status boolean, and a repair cost decimal. Write a helper function that takes a year that might be missing and returns a decade string, or nothing if the year is missing. Write another helper function that takes a condition string that can be omitted and returns a quality multiplier float, returning nothing if the condition is too poor. The main entry function `evaluate(cameras)` takes a list of camera structures and a threshold integer that may not be provided, returning a list of model names. It filters the cameras based on the decade being present, the quality multiplier being present, and the light meter being true if present. Example: evaluating a list with a Leica missing its year and condition should return an empty list.

title: Dinosaur bone registry
spec: Create a data structure for a paleontology find containing a species string, plus five fields that could be missing: an estimated age integer, a bone type string, a weight float, a museum location string, and a complete skeleton boolean. Write a logic routine that accepts an age integer that might be missing and returns an era classification string, or nothing if the age is absent. Provide a second routine that accepts a museum string which can be omitted and returns a shipping zone integer, or nothing if omitted. The entry function `register(finds)` processes a list of these finds and an urgency boolean that can be missing, returning a count of valid finds. A find is valid if it has an era classification, a shipping zone, and the weight is present and above ten. Example: an input with a Raptor bone missing its age and museum location returns zero.

title: Vintage typewriter assessment
spec: Establish a record representing a typewriter with a brand string, and five attributes that may not be provided: a manufacturing year integer, a missing keys count integer, a ribbon color string, a carriage return working boolean, and a rusted parts boolean. Develop a function taking a year that can be absent, returning a rarity score integer, or nothing if the year is unknown. Develop another function taking a missing keys count that might be missing, returning a repair cost float, or nothing if the count exceeds five. The entry point `assess(machines)` accepts a list of typewriter records and an optional discount float that can be absent. It returns a list of brand strings for machines that have a rarity score, a valid repair cost, and an intact carriage return. Example: a Royal brand machine with missing year and missing keys returns an empty list.

title: Symphony score catalog
spec: Design a data layout for a musical score with a composer string, along with five details that can be missing: a completion year integer, a tempo marking string, a key signature string, a dedication name string, and a missing pages count integer. Implement a helper that evaluates a completion year which can be omitted, returning a period string like baroque or classical, or nothing if absent. Implement a second helper evaluating a missing pages count that might be missing, returning a restoration effort float, or nothing if the count is over ten. The main function `catalog(scores)` takes a list of these layouts and a display limit integer that may not be provided. It returns a list of composer strings for scores where the period is identified, the restoration effort is present, and a key signature is known. Example: a Bach score missing its year and page count returns an empty list.

title: Sunken vessel dive log
spec: Model a dive record containing a vessel name string, and five measurements that might be absent: a depth integer, a visibility integer, an artifact recovered string, a current speed float, and a hazard warning boolean. Create a processing routine that checks a depth integer that could be missing, returning a diver certification requirement string, or nothing if the depth is unknown. Create another routine checking a visibility integer which can be omitted, returning a safety rating float, or nothing if visibility is under five. The core function `review(dives)` accepts a list of dive records and an optional filter string that can be absent, returning a count of approved dives. A dive is approved if the certification requirement is present, the safety rating exists, and no hazard warning is true. Example: a Titanic dive missing depth and visibility returns zero.

title: Exotic flower catalog
spec: Formulate a plant entry with a species string, and five characteristics that may not be provided: a blooming month integer, a color variant string, a fragrance description string, an elevation found float, and an endangered status boolean. Construct a utility function taking a blooming month that can be missing, returning a season string, or nothing if the month is absent. Construct a second utility taking an elevation float that might be omitted, returning a climate zone integer, or nothing if the elevation is negative. The primary function `compile(plants)` takes a list of plant entries and a region string that can be absent, returning a list of species strings. It selects plants that have a recognized season, a valid climate zone, and are not marked endangered. Example: an Orchid missing its month and elevation returns an empty list.

title: Meteor shower observation
spec: Set up a structure for a celestial event having a shower name string, and five properties that could be missing: a peak rate integer, a radiant constellation string, a moon illumination float, a parent comet string, and a cloud cover boolean. Build a helper evaluating a peak rate that can be omitted, returning an intensity category string, or nothing if the rate is zero. Build another helper evaluating a moon illumination float that might be missing, returning a visibility multiplier float, or nothing if the illumination is too high. The execution function `analyze(events)` handles a list of event structures and a minimum intensity string that can be absent. It returns the count of favorable events, which are those possessing an intensity category, a visibility multiplier, and no cloud cover. Example: a Perseids event missing its peak rate and moon data returns zero.

title: Medieval armor piece
spec: Define a historical item record with an armor type string, and five aspects that may not be provided: an origin country string, a weight float, a battle damage boolean, a forging century integer, and a maker mark string. Write a logic function that accepts a forging century that can be missing, returning a historical era string, or nothing if absent. Write a second function accepting a weight float that might be omitted, returning a mobility penalty integer, or nothing if the weight is excessive. The entry function `inspect(items)` processes a list of item records and a specific era string that can be absent, returning a list of armor types. Items are kept if they have an era string, a valid mobility penalty, and are free of battle damage. Example: a helmet missing its century and weight returns an empty list.

title: Bird nest survey
spec: Create a survey record for a nest featuring a bird species string, alongside five observations that could be missing: a tree type string, an egg count integer, a nest height float, a material description string, and a predator presence boolean. Provide a helper taking an egg count that can be omitted, returning a viability score float, or nothing if the count is zero. Provide another helper taking a nest height that might be absent, returning a canopy layer string, or nothing if the height is unrecorded. The main function `survey(nests)` accepts a list of survey records and a target layer string that may not be provided. It returns the total number of secure nests, defined as those having a viability score, a known canopy layer, and no predators present. Example: a Robin nest missing egg count and height returns zero.

title: Loose leaf tea tasting
spec: Outline a tasting note structure with an origin region string, and five attributes that may not be provided: a flush season string, a liquor color string, a steeping time integer, a flavor note string, and an astringency boolean. Implement a utility accepting a steeping time that can be absent, returning a brew strength string, or nothing if the time is too short. Implement a second utility accepting a flush season that might be missing, returning a quality tier integer, or nothing if the season is unrecognized. The entry function `evaluate(teas)` takes a list of tasting notes and an expected color string that can be omitted. It outputs a list of origin regions for teas that possess a brew strength, a quality tier, and are not astringent. Example: a Darjeeling missing its steeping time and season returns an empty list.

title: Lighthouse registry
spec: Model a maritime beacon with a structure name string, and five details that could be missing: a focal height float, a lens order integer, an automation year integer, a flash pattern string, and a fog signal boolean. Design a routine checking a focal height that can be omitted, returning a visibility range integer, or nothing if the height is missing. Design another routine checking a lens order that might be absent, returning a historical value float, or nothing if the order is not between one and six. The primary function `register(beacons)` processes a list of maritime beacons and a minimum range integer that can be absent, returning a count of significant beacons. A beacon is significant if it has a visibility range, a historical value, and an active fog signal. Example: a beacon missing its height and lens order returns zero.

title: Glacier monitoring
spec: Develop a survey record for an ice mass containing a glacier name string, and five measurements that may not be provided: a retreat rate float, a terminus elevation integer, a meltwater volume float, a flow speed float, and a bedrock exposed boolean. Write a function evaluating a retreat rate that can be missing, returning a danger level string, or nothing if the rate is normal. Write another function evaluating a terminus elevation that might be absent, returning a climate zone string, or nothing if the elevation is too low. The core function `monitor(glaciers)` takes a list of survey records and a specific danger level string that can be omitted. It returns a list of glacier names for those exhibiting a danger level, a known climate zone, and no exposed bedrock. Example: a glacier missing its retreat rate and elevation returns an empty list.

title: Vinyl record grading
spec: Establish a collector record for an album with an artist string, and five features that could be missing: a pressing year integer, a sleeve condition string, a media grade string, an rpm speed integer, and a scratched boolean. Construct a helper taking a pressing year that can be absent, returning a vintage status string, or nothing if the year is after two thousand. Construct another helper taking a media grade that might be omitted, returning a market value float, or nothing if the grade is poor. The entry function `grade(albums)` accepts a list of collector records and a minimum value float that may not be provided. It outputs a count of premium albums, which must have a vintage status, a market value, and no scratches. Example: an album missing its year and grade returns zero.

title: Coral reef bleaching
spec: Create a marine record for a reef area with a reef name string, and five indicators that may not be provided: a water temperature float, an affected area percentage float, a dominant species string, a recovery sign boolean, and a bleaching severity integer. Implement a logic piece accepting a temperature that can be missing, returning a thermal stress string, or nothing if the temperature is normal. Implement a second piece accepting an affected percentage that might be omitted, returning a damage category integer, or nothing if the percentage is below ten. The main function `assess(reefs)` processes a list of marine records and a target species string that can be absent. It returns a list of reef names that show thermal stress, a damage category, and lack any recovery sign. Example: a reef missing temperature and percentage data returns an empty list.

title: Castle ruin assessment
spec: Define a heritage site structure with a fortification name string, and five attributes that could be missing: a built century integer, a moat depth float, a surviving tower count integer, a wall thickness float, and a tourist access boolean. Provide a utility checking a built century that can be omitted, returning an architectural style string, or nothing if the century is unrecorded. Provide another utility checking a tower count that might be absent, returning a structural integrity float, or nothing if the count is zero. The entry function `inspect(sites)` takes a list of heritage structures and an architectural style string that can be missing, returning a count of preserved sites. A preserved site has an architectural style, a structural integrity score, and tourist access. Example: a site missing its century and tower count returns zero.

title: Essential oil distillation
spec: Formulate a batch record with a botanical name string, and five parameters that may not be provided: an extraction time integer, a yield percentage float, a steam temperature float, a solvent used string, and a pure extract boolean. Build a function taking an extraction time that can be missing, returning a process efficiency string, or nothing if the time is too long. Build a second function taking a yield percentage that might be omitted, returning a commercial grade integer, or nothing if the yield is too low. The core function `evaluate(batches)` accepts a list of batch records and a desired grade integer that can be absent, returning a list of botanical names. Selected batches must possess a process efficiency, a commercial grade, and be marked as pure. Example: a Lavender batch missing extraction time and yield returns an empty list.

title: Scrapbooking paper supply
spec: Outline a supply item for crafting with a pattern name string, and five properties that could be missing: a paper weight float, a texture type string, a sheet width integer, a manufacturer string, and a foil stamped boolean. Write a routine evaluating a paper weight that can be omitted, returning a durability string, or nothing if the weight is excessive. Write another routine evaluating a sheet width that might be absent, returning a project scale float, or nothing if the width is too small. The main function `catalog(supplies)` processes a list of supply items and a texture string that may not be provided, returning a count of versatile papers. A versatile paper has a durability rating, a project scale, and is not foil stamped. Example: a supply missing weight and width returns zero.

title: Woodworking hand plane
spec: Design an antique tool record with a blade brand string, and five characteristics that may not be provided: a blade width float, a sole material string, a tote condition string, a frog angle integer, and a rusted body boolean. Develop a helper accepting a blade width that can be missing, returning a usage category string, or nothing if the width is invalid. Develop a second helper accepting a frog angle that might be omitted, returning a smoothing performance float, or nothing if the angle is extreme. The entry function `review(tools)` takes a list of tool records and a material string that can be absent, returning a list of blade brands. Tools are chosen if they have a usage category, a smoothing performance score, and no rust. Example: a Stanley tool missing its width and frog angle returns an empty list.

title: Cathedral window restoration
spec: Model a glass panel record with a window location string, and five details that could be missing: a lead came thickness float, a glass color string, a soldering flux type string, a crack length float, and a bowing warped boolean. Create a logic piece checking a lead came thickness that can be omitted, returning a structural rating string, or nothing if it is too thin. Create another piece checking a crack length that might be absent, returning a repair urgency integer, or nothing if the crack is minor. The primary function `assess(panels)` handles a list of panel records and an urgency limit integer that can be missing. It returns a count of critical panels, defined as those having a structural rating, a repair urgency, and exhibiting bowing. Example: a panel missing its thickness and crack length returns zero.

title: Vintage fountain pen
spec: Set up an writing instrument structure with a model string, and five features that may not be provided: a nib size integer, a filling mechanism string, a barrel material string, an ink capacity float, and a cracked section boolean. Implement a utility taking a nib size that can be missing, returning a stroke width string, or nothing if the size is unrecognized. Implement a second utility taking an ink capacity that might be omitted, returning a writing duration float, or nothing if the capacity is too low. The core function `grade(pens)` accepts a list of pen structures and a target stroke string that can be absent, returning a list of models. Good pens must have a stroke width, a writing duration, and no cracked sections. Example: a pen missing its nib size and capacity returns an empty list.

title: Underground cave exploration
spec: Define a cavern log entry with a chamber name string, and five measurements that could be missing: a stalactite length float, an underground river depth float, a bat species string, an air temperature float, and a flooded passage boolean. Write a function that processes a stalactite length that can be omitted, returning an age estimation string, or nothing if the length is too small. Write another function that processes a river depth that might be absent, returning a navigation difficulty integer, or nothing if the river is shallow. The entry function `map(logs)` takes a list of cavern entries and an equipment string that may not be provided. It returns the count of challenging chambers, which must have an age estimation, a navigation difficulty, and no flooded passages. Example: a chamber missing length and depth returns zero.

title: Satellite dish calibration
spec: Create a hardware record for a communications dish with a dish model string, and five specifications that may not be provided: a signal gain float, a rotation speed float, a reflector material string, a motor current float, and a feedhorn damaged boolean. Provide a helper evaluating a signal gain that can be missing, returning an operating band string, or nothing if the gain is insufficient. Provide another helper evaluating a rotation speed that might be omitted, returning a tracking precision float, or nothing if the speed is erratic. The main function `inspect(dishes)` processes a list of hardware records and a material string that can be absent, returning a list of dish models. Operational dishes must have an operating band, a tracking precision, and no damaged feedhorns. Example: a dish missing gain and rotation speed returns an empty list.

title: Mechanical keyboard build
spec: Formulate a component list for a keyboard with a layout name string, and five attributes that could be missing: a switch type string, a keycap profile string, a plate material string, an actuation force float, and a foam dampened boolean. Build a routine accepting an actuation force that can be omitted, returning a typing feel string, or nothing if the force is too heavy. Build a second routine accepting a switch type that might be absent, returning a sound profile integer, or nothing if the switch is unknown. The core function `evaluate(builds)` handles a list of component lists and a typing feel string that may not be provided, returning a count of premium builds. A premium build requires a typing feel, a sound profile, and must be foam dampened. Example: a build missing its force and switch type returns zero.

title: Historic sailing ship
spec: Outline a maritime vessel record with a ship name string, and five details that may not be provided: a mast height float, a sail area float, a hull wood type string, a cannon count integer, and a barnacle encrusted boolean. Develop a logic piece taking a mast height that can be missing, returning a wind class string, or nothing if the height is too short. Develop a second piece taking a cannon count that might be omitted, returning a firepower rating float, or nothing if the count is zero. The entry function `review(ships)` accepts a list of vessel records and a hull type string that can be absent, returning a list of ship names. A formidable ship must have a wind class, a firepower rating, and not be heavily encrusted. Example: a ship missing its mast height and cannon count returns an empty list.

title: Kombucha brewing log
spec: Model a fermentation log with a batch name string, and five observations that could be missing: a tea type string, a sugar concentration float, an ambient temperature float, a fermentation time integer, and a mold present boolean. Create a utility function checking a sugar concentration that can be omitted, returning a sweetness profile string, or nothing if the concentration is extreme. Create another utility checking a fermentation time that might be absent, returning a tartness score float, or nothing if the time exceeds thirty days.
